paite: Alal lai hun in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in huai gam ahong dou a, Jehoiakim bel asikha in kum thum a-om hi. Huai nung in alehngatsan a, atung ah ahelta hi.
TOUPA'N Kaldai pawlte, Siria pawlte, Moab pawlte, Ammon suan pawlte amah sual ding in asawlkhia a, asikha zawlneite zang a agen TOUPA thu bang in Judah gam hihsesak ding in asawl hi.
Manasseh khelhna, athilhih tengteng ziak a, amuh phaklouhna a amaute suanmang ding in, Judah tung ah TOUPA thupiak ahong tung petmah hi.
Midik sisan asuah ziak in leng; midik sisan a Jerusalem ahihdim ziak in leng TOUPA'N amah angaidam kei hi.
Huchi in Jehoiakim tanchin dang leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah tuang ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Jehoiakim bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; asik in atapa Jehoiakin alalta hi.
Aigupta kumpipa agam a pan ahong kuankhe nawn kei; Babulon kumpipa'n Aigupta gam lui a pan Euphrates Luipi pha a kumpipa gam huap tengteng alak zoh tak ziak in.
Jehoiakin bel alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-giat a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kha thum alal a, anu min Nehushta, Jerusalem a Elnathan tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakin / (2 Kro 36.9,10)

paite: Apa hihdan tengteng hih in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
Huchih lai in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar sikhate Jerusalem ah ahohtou ua, khua ava um uhi.
Huchi a asikhate'n ava um lai un khua ah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar ava hohtou hi,
Huchi in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin, anu, asikhate, amiliante, aheutute toh Babulon kumpipa kiang ah ava pawtkhia ua; alal akum giatna kum in Babulon kumpipa'n ana man hi.
TOUPA gen bang in, a-inn a gou tengteng leh kumpipa' inn a gou tengteng ala vek a, TOUPA tempul a Israelte kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng tui-um belsuan abawl tengteng asatgawp vek hi.
Jerusalem a mi tengteng, milian tengteng, mihat hangsan hoih tengteng, singkhat leh khutsiam leh siksekmi tengteng sal in api vek hi. Huai gam a migentheite chih louh kuamah a-omta kei uhi.
Jehoiakin bel Babulon ah api a; kumpipa nu, kumpinute, aheutute leh huai gam a mihatte Jerusalem a pan Babulon ah sal in api hi.
Babulon kumpipa'n pasal hoih tengteng sangsagih leh khutsiam leh siksekmi sangkhat, mihat hoih teng gal dou thei mi ngen Babulon ah sal in api vek hi.
Apa unaupa Mattaniah, Babulon kumpipa'n asik in alalsak a, amin Zedekiah chi in akheksak hi.
Zedekiah bel alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-khat a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat sung alal a; anu min Hamutal, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah / (2 Kro 36.11,12; Jer 52.1-3)

paite: Jehoiakim hihdan tengteng bang in ahih a, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
TOUPA hehna tawn in Jerusalem leh Judah tung ah Zedekiah, Babulon kumpipa tung a ahel a pan ama'n amuh phak louh dia apaihmang masiah hiai thilte ahong tungta hi.
